notes: §2002:12.3.4.3 GR5: the indexed format defines a connector for an indexed file; §2002:12.3.4.9.2 GR4: indexed organization identifies each record by the value of its keys; §2002:9.1.8.1: sequential access of an indexed file is ascending on the key of reference. pb742's IXF (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, RECORD KEY IS IX-KEY, ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS IX-ALT WITH DUPLICATES) writes CC, AA, BB and its READ NEXT walk prints 'PRIME WALK:' then '  AA ZZ ONE', '  BB YY TWO', '  CC ZZ TRI': key order, not arrival order, which only an indexed connector gives. pb742_legal_entry_formats_85 run at --std 2002 on the pinned build: PASS (output equals its .out, exit 0).
